title: The Timber Levy
summary: Fill the levy out of the Pinewater cut: eight hundred of timber and two hundred and ten of stone, cut and carried home before the column comes back through at dusk.

victory_conditions.description: Cut and carry home eight hundred of timber and two hundred and ten of stone. The near stand was stripped bare; the deep pines and the east screen are the only timber left standing.

optional_objectives.description: Overcut the levy. A surplus is the only thing a quartermaster has ever thanked anyone for.

defeat_conditions.description: The column came back through and the carts were still empty. A levy that misses the road is a levy nobody signed for.
The officer of the detail falls. Nobody else here can sign for the levy.
The crew is gone and the officer is standing in a clearing with an axe. That is not a work party.

commander_messages.speaker: roman_field_commander
commander_messages.text: Eight hundred of timber and two hundred of stone, and the near stand was stripped by the last detail. That means the deep pines, which means the long road, which means whatever is living in the deep pines gets a look at us. The column comes back through at dusk and it does not wait. Split the crew. Escort the far one.

commander_messages.speaker: roman_field_commander
commander_messages.text: Light is going. Five minutes of road left in the day, and whatever is on the carts when the column reaches us is what we levied. Bring them home.

commander_messages.speaker: roman_field_commander
commander_messages.text: Levy filled. Stack it by the road and let the carts argue about it. We cut a wood down to feed a siege that has not started yet — remember that the next time somebody calls this the quiet posting.

commander_messages.speaker: roman_field_commander
commander_messages.text: Leave the axes. Leave the carts. A detail that cannot fill its own levy before the column comes through does not get to carry anything.

theme: The wood is worth more than the men who cut it. Somebody decided that in a tent, far from here.
